warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.50 + 3.50 (7.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.50 + 3.50 + 2.50 (9.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, both S-02 views, S-03, S-04, A-03, A-04 and the elevations A-05..A-08 (A-06/A-08 letter A-B-C-D with 3.50 / 3.50 / 2.50). Vector CAD PDF; dimension values are drawn as vectors (not in the text layer), every value read off the rendered page.

Lettering conflict, decided: A-10 รูปตัด B prints markers A-B-C-D-E at 2.00 | 3.50 | 3.50 | 2.50, and the small S-03 view 'แบบโครงสร้างหลังคา ระดับ +4.01' prints D-E at 2.50 + 1.00. Both letter the rows one step later than every other sheet (S-01, S-02 x2, S-03 main view, S-04, A-03 x2, A-04, A-06, A-08 = 10 views agree on A-B-C-D = 3.50 / 3.50 / 2.50, and only four rows of footings exist on S-01). Op01 precedence: structural plans win grid geometry, more sheets beat fewer. Their chains are recorded in structural lettering (printed B-E = A-D; printed D-E on the +4.01 view = C-D, with the column C1 that S-02 draws alone at D1). A-10's extra printed 'A', 2.00 before structural A, became the dummy A' (-2.00) because a dimension is printed to it (section 4 rule 4); it carries confidence 0.5 since nothing is drawn there.

x dummies: 1' (-1.00) and 3' (8.00) roof edges (S-04/A-04 1.00 overhangs); 1'' (0.10) and 1''' (1.20) stair ST-01 edges from the A-11 chain 3.400 = 1.100 + 2.300 measured from grid 2; 1'''' (2.50) roof chain 2.50 + 1.00; 2' (5.10) S-02/A-03 second-floor chain 1.60 + 1.90 (beam B2 between the bathroom slabs); 2'' (5.25) roof chain 1.75 + 1.75 (Truss T4). 2' and 2'' are 0.15 apart and are two different printed points, both kept.

y dummies: A'' (-1.00) and D' (10.50) roof edges; A''' / A'''' and B' / B'' are the S-04 rafter ticks (1.167 x 3 per 3.50 bay; 3 x 1.167 = 3.501 — inner ticks positioned off the upper line, last segment absorbs 0.001); A''''' (2.50) second-floor chain 2.50 + 1.00 (beam B3 under the bathrooms); C' (8.00) S-03/S-04/A-04 1.00 tick; C''' (8.25) S-04 0.25 + 1.25 tick; C'' (8.10) and C'''' (9.20) stair ST-01 chain 1.100 + 1.100 + 0.300 (A-11).

z: datum ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน. Every elevation and both building sections print the same chain 2.98 + 3.05 + 1.01 + 1.01 = 8.05. Two different ridges carry the same printed label 'ระดับหลังอกไก่' (+7.04 and +8.05), so their ids keep the printed value. Footing depths (1.00 below ระดับดินเดิม, 0.30/0.35 footing, 0.05 lean concrete, 0.05 sand), truss heights (T1 2.193, T2 0.600, T3 1.183 + 1.921, T4 0.600) and the stair rise (16 @ 0.174 = 2.78) are member-internal and stay on their elements.

Truss elevations on S-05 print panel chains (T1 0.875 x 8, T2 1.167 x 6, T3 3.50 + 0.875 x 4, T4 1.250 x 2) with no grid bubbles under them; they are kept on the truss elements as member-internal dimensions, not as grid ticks. T2's 1.167 panels coincide with the S-04 rafter ticks that are already lines.

Dimension sweep covers S-01..S-08, A-03 (floor plans), A-04 (roof plan), A-05..A-08 (elevations), A-09/A-10 (sections) and A-11 (stair). Not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run: A-01 (notes), A-12 (sanitary fixture heights), A-13 (door/window sizes — on the schedule elements), E-01/E-02, SN-01..SN-03.
